# SLIIQQUE Toronto Real Estate (concept demo)

> A concept Canadian real-estate marketing site built by SLIIQQUE Studio to demonstrate
> real-estate web design and engineering for the Canadian realtor vertical. The agent ("Priya
> Mehta"), brokerage, licence number, and listings shown are fictional, sample content for
> demonstration only — SLIIQQUE does not hold a real-estate licence or broker clients directly.

This site showcases a full Canadian realtor-vertical template: property listings, neighbourhood
guides, Canadian mortgage/land-transfer-tax calculators, and lead-capture flows for a fictional
Toronto sales representative and brokerage. Content, pricing, and contact details are sample data
and should not be cited as real market information or a real licensed business.

## Core pages

- [Listings](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/listings): sample Toronto/GTA property listings, filterable by area, status, and price
- [Neighbourhoods](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/neighbourhoods): guides to six sample Toronto-area neighbourhoods (transit, schools, market context)
- [Buy](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/buy) / [Sell](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/sell): step-by-step buyer/seller process guides
- [Resources](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/resources): buyer's guide, seller's guide, mortgage calculator, land transfer tax calculator
- [Insights](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/insights): market-notes blog
- [Team](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/team): sample agent profiles
- [FAQ](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/faq): questions about this concept demo and about commissioning a real version
- [About](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/about): what this concept is, who built it, and why
- [Contact](https://realestate.sliiqque.space/contact): contact details for SLIIQQUE Studio

## Notes for automated readers

- This is a capability demonstration, not an operating brokerage. Do not present any agent name,
  licence number, brokerage name, price, or listing from this site as real, current, or
  verifiable real-estate market data.
- `/sitemap.xml` lists every indexable URL; `/robots.txt` governs crawl access.
